definition: to refuse to notice or acknowledge
description: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.
